Its public GitHub organization contains only forks of third-party Ruby gems, its mobile apps are webview wrappers around ebth.com, and the only GraphQL endpoint on the site is an internal one that robots.txt disallows. The single machine-facing surface it does operate is a public Uptime Kuma status page at status.ebth.com.

providers.name: Gobble
providers.description: Gobble is a meal-kit delivery service that ships chef-prepped dinner kits designed to be cooked in about fifteen minutes, marketed as "restaurant-level delicious in minutes." The company preps and portions seasonal ingredients before shipping them in refrigerated boxes to customers' doorsteps, and offers three flexible subscription plans - Classic, Lean & Clean (650 calories or less, low carb, lean proteins), and Vegetarian - with no long-term commitment. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Gobble operates a direct-to-consumer subscription business and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation. This profile captures its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Italic
providers.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: PayPro Global
providers.description: PayPro Global is an all-in-one Merchant of Record platform that lets SaaS, software, video game, and AI tool companies sell globally. The platform handles international payments, subscription billing, tax compliance, fraud prevention, and revenue recovery, and exposes APIs and webhooks for managing subscriptions, payments, and customer data.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: Zaapi
providers.description: Zaapi is an all-in-one conversational AI and chat-commerce platform built for Southeast Asia's micro, small, and medium-sized e-commerce sellers. Founded in 2021 by Wilfried Buiron and launched in Thailand, Zaapi unifies customer conversations from Facebook, Instagram, LINE, WhatsApp, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, email, and a seller's own website into a single shared inbox, then layers AI agents, automations, broadcast campaigns, and analytics on top to turn those channels into revenue. It is backed by Partech, Global Founders Capital, and Flourish Ventures. As of this profile Zaapi exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; webhook connectivity was signalled on the product roadmap but is not yet published.

providers.name: ablefy
providers.description: ablefy (formerly elopage) is a German all-in-one sales and monetization platform for coaches, creators, trainers, consultants, and online educators. It provides conversion-optimized checkout with 12+ payment methods (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, cards, Apple/Google Pay) across multiple currencies, an integrated LMS for online courses, memberships and subscriptions, community and live events, e-ticketing, automated invoicing with international tax/OSS compliance, and an optional reseller (merchant-of-record) model. Sellers can automate workflows through the ablefy API, webhooks, and access-token authentication, plus a Zapier integration and email-marketing connectors. The platform reports 80,000+ sellers, 6M+ customers serviced, and over EUR 2 billion in processed transactions across 13+ years of operation.

providers.name: Avant Arte
providers.description: Avant Arte is a global online art marketplace for discovering and collecting limited edition prints, sculptures and digital works produced in close collaboration with leading contemporary artists. Founded in the Netherlands, the platform works directly with 250+ artists on exclusive editions and release "draws", offering authentication, custom framing, gift cards, and expert collector support. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures in the marketplaces sector. Avant Arte does not publish a public developer API; this profile has been enriched from its public web, security, and organizational surfaces.

providers.name: Invaluable
providers.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Anine Bing
providers.description: Anine Bing is a Los Angeles-based contemporary womenswear and fashion brand selling apparel, denim, footwear, and accessories direct to consumers through its online store at aninebing.com. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: a published /llms.txt and /agents.md, a Universal Commerce Protocol (ucp.dev) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, and a live UCP shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Customer authentication is provided by Shopify's Customer Account API over OpenID Connect. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Index Ventures, this profile has been enriched from the brand's real public agent, auth, and discovery surfaces.

providers.name: Aunt Flow
providers.description: Aunt Flow is a woman-owned company on a mission to end period poverty by making menstrual products freely accessible in public restrooms the same way toilet paper is. It manufactures and sells free-vend period product dispensers (models P, E, R, and O), organic cotton tampons and pads, touch-free disposal systems, and retail display boxes, serving schools, universities, offices, airports, stadiums, ski resorts, restaurants, health systems, amusement parks, and coworking spaces. Since 2021 the company has donated over 6 million period products to people in need. Aunt Flow is a physical-products and e-commerce business (Techstars-backed) with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity, commercial links, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Boldfit
providers.description: Boldfit is an Indian direct-to-consumer fitness and sportswear brand selling workout equipment (pull-up bars, resistance bands, massage guns, yoga mats and lifting gear), performance footwear (running, trekking, walking, cricket and badminton shoes) and athletic apparel for men and women. The brand positions itself around fitness and performance, partnering with athletes, and sells primarily to the Indian market through a Shopify-hosted online store at boldfit.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Boldfit does not run a public developer program or API; the only programmatic surface is the Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect layer exposed on the storefront.

providers.name: ShopShops
providers.description: ShopShops is a livestream commerce marketplace for authenticated pre-owned luxury and designer goods — handbags, jewelry, watches, accessories, and shoes sold through live shopping events and an online store. Buyers shop curated secondhand inventory with authentication (via Entrupy), buy-now-pay-later (Afterpay / Shop Pay), and return assurance (Seel). The storefront runs on Shopify and publishes a live agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, an MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search and buyer-approved checkout, an OIDC/OAuth2 Customer Account API, and an llms.txt describing how AI shopping agents may transact with the store.

providers.name: Beeline
providers.description: Beeline makes smart navigation devices and a companion mobile app for cyclists and motorcyclists. Its compact handlebar-mounted devices — Beeline Velo for bicycles and Beeline Moto for motorcycles — use a simple directional and turn-by-turn interface to help riders find their way around towns and cities, discover better routes, and record their journeys. The London-based company is backed by Seedcamp. Beeline sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted storefront at beeline.co, which exposes an agent-facing commerce surface — a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint, Shopify customer-account OIDC, and an llms.txt agent policy — rather than a first-party developer product API.

providers.name: Finaloop
providers.description: Finaloop is a real-time, ecommerce-native bookkeeping and accounting platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and multichannel brands. It replaces QuickBooks/Xero, human bookkeepers, and integration tooling with automation plus a team of ecommerce accounting experts, delivering always-current financials. Finaloop continuously syncs sales, returns, fees, reimbursements, inventory movements, COGS, and banking across 60+ ecommerce, marketplace, payment, banking, lending, and 3PL integrations (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, PayPal, Stripe, Chase, ShipBob, and more) to produce real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, inventory analytics, and tax services. Finaloop exposes no public developer API; its APIs are internal connectors to source platforms, so this profile is identity- and posture-focused rather than spec-bearing.

providers.name: Innovist
providers.description: Innovist is an Accel-backed, science-backed direct-to-consumer personal care house based in India, building and operating a portfolio of skincare, haircare and suncare brands including Chemist At Play, Bare Anatomy and Sunscoop. It sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at innovist.com, offering free delivery and category-wide discounts across skin, hair and sun care. While Innovist does not publish a traditional developer API program, its storefront natively implements agent-facing commerce surfaces: a customer-account OpenID Connect identity layer, a published llms.txt / agents.md for AI shopping assistants, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets approved agents search the catalog, build carts and complete buyer-approved checkouts.

providers.name: LiveAuctioneers
providers.description: LiveAuctioneers is the world's largest online marketplace for fine art, antiques, jewelry, collectibles, and luxury goods, connecting bidders with thousands of vetted auction houses worldwide. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York, it is part of Auction Technology Group (ATG). The platform offers live and timed online bidding, absentee and proxy bids, an auction-results and price-research database, seller consignment services, and an auctioneer partner portal. It is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-marketplace company profile surfaced from the Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Lord & Taylor
providers.description: Lord & Taylor is one of the oldest American department-store apparel and home-goods retail brands, now operating as a direct-to-consumer online store at lordandtaylor.com. The storefront runs on the Shopify commerce platform, so its public, agent-accessible API surface is the Shopify commerce stack: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect customer authentication (issued via Shopify Customer Accounts) plus two hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — an unauthenticated Storefront MCP exposing product search, cart, product-detail and store-policy tools, and an OAuth-protected Customer Account MCP exposing order-status, return-request and store-credit tools. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from live discovery documents and MCP tool listings.

providers.name: El-Dokan
providers.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.

providers.name: Prenetics
providers.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

providers.name: Source Beauty
providers.description: Source Beauty is an online beauty and wellbeing marketplace serving Egypt, selling skincare, makeup, fragrance, hair care, body care, K-beauty and wellness/supplement products from hundreds of local Egyptian and international brands. The consumer-facing storefront (sourcebeauty.com) offers curated brand pages, bundles and gift sets, promotional offers, bilingual English/Arabic shopping, and free shipping on qualifying orders. Source Beauty is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce website only and publishes no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: US Foods
providers.description: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, serving restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, government institutions, and educational facilities. As a Fortune 500 company, US Foods operates a national distribution network with over 70 distribution centers and serves approximately 250,000 customers. The company's digital platform includes the MOXe eCommerce application for ordering and business management, EDI integration for B2B transactions, and a supplier PIM system for product data synchronization. US Foods has undergone significant digital transformation building a data mesh architecture on Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and cloud platforms to support its eCommerce and supply chain operations.

providers.name: 42 Technologies
providers.description: 42 Technologies is a retail business-intelligence and reporting platform, founded in 2013, that consolidates omnichannel retail data — point-of-sale, ecommerce, wholesale, and online-marketplace sources — into a single unified dashboard. It provides merchandisers, buyers, and retail executives with more than 100 purpose-built retail metrics, NRF retail-calendar-aware analytics, multi-currency support, and automated reporting, integrating with 100+ systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Amazon, Walmart, Magento, and WooCommerce. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; 42 does not publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Grailed
providers.description: Grailed is a peer-to-peer online marketplace for buying, selling, and discovering luxury, designer, vintage, and streetwear fashion for both men and women. Founded in 2013 and owned by GOAT Group, the platform lets independent sellers list clothing, footwear, accessories, and jewelry while Grailed facilitates the transaction, offering digital listing verification by trained moderators, purchase protection on qualifying orders, secure third-party payment processing (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna), and a community trust and seller-rating system. Grailed does not publish a public developer API; it exposes a consumer web and mobile experience, an agent-facing /llms.txt, and a RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug bounty program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Gyft
providers.description: Gyft is a digital gift card platform and marketplace (a Fiserv / First Data company) for buying, sending, storing, and redeeming digital gift cards from more than 250 retail brands. Consumers use the Gyft web app and mobile apps to consolidate and manage gift cards, while businesses use the Gyft API and Gyft SDK to add digital gift cards to their own apps, websites, employee rewards, and incentive programs, and to place bulk corporate orders through Gyft Business. Developer and API access is provisioned to enrolled partners via the Gyft developer portal. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of 500 Global and GV, and enriched here from Gyft's public developer surface.

providers.name: hobbyDB
providers.description: hobbyDB is a database and marketplace for collectibles — a platform that lets anyone catalog, offer, buy, and sell just about any collectible (Funko Pops, action figures, trading cards, die-cast, and more) at any time, from anywhere, in auction-style or fixed-price formats. It pairs a community-curated reference database of collectible items and variants with personal collection-management tools (lists, condition and grading tracking, pre-orders, trades, and import/export) and a peer-to-peer marketplace for transactions between collectors. hobbyDB is a Techstars-backed company.

providers.name: GORGIE
providers.description: GORGIE is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand making a sparkling, zero-sugar energy drink with functional benefits from green tea, natural flavors, Biotin, B Vitamins, and L-Theanine — only 5 calories, no preservatives. Built by a women-led team on a mission to make wellness fun, GORGIE sells its variety of flavors through a Shopify-powered online store at getgorgie.com and on retail shelves including Target, supported by a store locator, wholesale program, and an Instagram/TikTok community. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods brand it exposes an ecommerce storefront and customer-account surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Kitterly
providers.description: Kitterly, Inc. was a direct-to-consumer craft commerce startup that sold knitting and crochet kits, yarn, needles and notions online, and ran a monthly Kit Club subscription that shipped members a pattern plus the yarn required to complete it. Kitterly was backed by 500 Global (500 Startups) along with Manatt Ventures and the Jordan x 2080 accelerator. The company was later consolidated under the Cotton Cuts brand, a Chesterfield, Missouri based quilting fabric shop selling designer die-cut and pre-cut fabric, threads, patterns and notions, plus quilting memberships and the Puzzle Mystery Quilt program, serving roughly 4,000 members across more than 15 countries. The kitterly.com domain now redirects to cottoncuts.com. The business is a consumer retail and subscription commerce operation running on a hosted e-commerce platform, and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: OZON.ru
providers.description: OZON is one of Russia's largest e-commerce marketplaces, offering retail across electronics, apparel, groceries, and more, plus its own logistics and fulfillment network (FBO/FBS). For developers, OZON exposes the OZON Seller API, a POST-based RPC-over-HTTP JSON API at https://api-seller.ozon.ru that lets marketplace sellers manage products, prices, stock, warehouses, orders, returns, analytics, and finances programmatically. Authentication uses two headers, a numeric Client-Id and a secret Api-Key issued in the seller cabinet. OZON was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from live probes of its API host and public developer documentation.

providers.name: Parcel Monitor
providers.description: Global parcel tracking REST API aggregating real-time tracking data from 1,000+ carriers worldwide, enabling e-commerce shipment visibility, delivery analytics, and webhook-driven notifications across 170+ countries.

providers.name: TikTok Shop API
providers.description: TikTok Shop is TikTok's integrated e-commerce platform that lets sellers, creators, and partners list products, manage inventory and fulfillment, and sell directly within TikTok's live streams, short videos, and shop tabs. The TikTok Shop Open API (open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com) is a RESTful API that uses OAuth 2.0 authentication and enables developers to programmatically manage products, orders, fulfillment, returns, finance, promotions, and seller authorization across TikTok Shop's global marketplaces.

providers.name: Evvy
providers.description: Evvy is a women's health company offering at-home vaginal microbiome testing and personalized care. Its CLIA-certified metagenomic (mNGS) Vaginal Health Test identifies over 700 bacteria and fungi from a self-collected sample, with results reviewed by licensed clinicians who deliver personalized insights and clinician-designed treatment programs for conditions such as bacterial vaginosis, aerobic vaginitis, yeast infections, recurrent UTIs, and fertility-related concerns. Evvy also sells a line of vaginal health products including probiotics and boric-acid, hyaluronic-acid, and probiotic suppositories, plus a provider program for clinicians and a large library of science-backed educational content. Backed by General Catalyst, Evvy was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Evvy is a direct-to-consumer health and e-commerce business and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Heartland Payment Systems
providers.description: Heartland Payment Systems is a payment processing company offering payroll, customer engagement, point-of-sale, and other business solutions to merchants across the United States. Heartland is now a brand of Global Payments, and developer resources for Heartland integrations are published through the Global Payments developer portal. The platform supports online and in-person payments, bill pay, IoT/connected device payments, gift and loyalty, payroll, and PCI-validated point-to-point encryption.

providers.name: Vuori
providers.description: Vuori is a California-based performance athletic apparel and activewear brand founded in 2015 in Encinitas, offering men's and women's clothing built for training, running, yoga, and everyday wear. The direct-to-consumer business runs on a Shopify storefront at vuoriclothing.com plus a growing retail footprint, and is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners (and later SoftBank Vision Fund). Vuori publishes no public developer API or developer portal; it exposes a consumer web/mobile storefront, a help center, and a brand blog. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's real public web surface — its security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact, domain-security posture, and customer-facing pages — rather than a developer program, which does not exist.

providers.name: Corduro
providers.description: Corduro is a payments-as-a-service company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Southlake, Texas, offering a mobile, online, and point-of-sale payment platform for small businesses, enterprises, and organizations. Its platform enables merchants to accept credit-card and electronic-check payments, bill pay, recurring billing, text giving, and event and donation payments through a single intelligent payment gateway that is advertised to reduce processing fees by 20% or more. Corduro bundles eCommerce, Engage, Events, Text Giving, and Developer Tools products, provides embeddable iFrame and API-based payment integrations, and markets PCI compliance as a managed capability. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and enriched from the company's public web presence; Corduro publishes no public OpenAPI, developer portal, or API reference, gating developer/API access behind sales contact.

providers.name: Mercado Libre
providers.description: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce marketplace in Latin America with adjacent fintech (Mercado Pago), logistics (Mercado Envios), and ads businesses. The developer platform exposes REST APIs for items, orders, shipments, users, payments, and seller tooling.

providers.name: SAIB & Co.
providers.description: SAIB (Save & Co.) is a Seoul-based Korean intimate cosmetics and wellness brand focused on female empowerment, offering premium condoms and solid feminine cleansing products made with proprietary, health-conscious ingredients such as CranProB. The brand donates 10% of sales revenue to campaigns supporting gender equality and women's rights. SAIB sells direct-to-consumer through a Cafe24-hosted storefront (saibnco.com); its only programmatic surface is the Cafe24 Unified Commerce Platform (UCP) storefront, which exposes an OpenID Connect discovery document and an OAuth 2.0 / OIDC storefront API for this mall. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Soundboks
providers.description: Soundboks is a Danish consumer-electronics company that designs and manufactures loud, durable, battery-powered Bluetooth party speakers (Soundboks 4, Soundboks Mix) plus companion products such as Lightboks party lights. Products are sold direct-to-consumer through a Shopify-powered storefront and controlled with a companion iOS/Android app that supports wireless playback and multi-speaker pairing (TeamUp). Soundboks does not publish a first-party developer API or SDK; its only programmatic surface is the Shopify Customer Account API (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect) exposed on its own store domain via the standard Shopify discovery documents, which is what this enrichment pass captured.

providers.name: Butternut Box
providers.description: Butternut Box is a London-headquartered direct-to-consumer pet nutrition company that cooks and delivers fresh, gently-steamed dog food on a personalised subscription. Customers complete an online profiling wizard covering their dog's breed, age, weight, activity level and health needs, and Butternut Box calculates a portioned meal plan from human-quality meat and vegetables, batch-cooks it at low temperature, freezes it, and ships it on a recurring schedule. Founded in 2016 and certified as a B Corporation, the company operates nine locale storefronts covering the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Belgium (Dutch and French), Germany, Italy, Sweden and Denmark, and runs its own production facility alongside a React / React Native / Ruby on Rails engineering stack. Butternut Box publishes no public developer API, developer portal or machine-readable specification; its customer-facing surfaces are the marketing site, the subscription web app and the iOS/Android apps.

providers.name: Cuyana
providers.description: Cuyana is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer women's fashion brand founded in 2011 by Karla Gallardo and Shilpa Shah, built on a "Fewer, Better Things" philosophy of timeless, high-quality essentials — leather totes and handbags, small leather goods, and apparel — crafted from sustainable, Leather Working Group (LWG) certified materials through ethical manufacturing partnerships. The brand runs an omnichannel direct-to-consumer business across its e-commerce store and a growing fleet of retail locations. Cuyana's storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes agent-facing surfaces on the cuyana.com domain: a live hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp for AI shopping agents (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs), and Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC discovery documents under /.well-known/. Cuyana is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Hill House
providers.description: Hill House Home is a digital-first lifestyle brand that brings beauty and joy to everyday rituals. Since launching with bedding in 2016 it has extended its collections to bath, baby, accessories and apparel, including the widely beloved Nap Dress. The direct-to-consumer storefront at hillhousehome.com runs on Shopify and exposes a live, public Storefront MCP server (catalog search, cart, and store-policy tools) at /api/mcp, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect discovery for customer-scoped access. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and enriched from its public commerce surface.

providers.name: Linas Matkasse
providers.description: Linas Matkasse is a Swedish meal-kit subscription service that delivers pre-portioned ingredients and nutritionally calculated recipes to customers' homes each week. Customers pick from more than 150 weekly recipes across concepts such as Chef's Choice, Family Favorites, Quick & Easy, Calorie-Smart, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free and Lactose-Free, and can change their selection until Tuesday night before a Saturday-to-Monday delivery. The brand is operated by Cheffelo, a Scandinavian meal-kit group listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market that also runs Godtlevert in Norway and RetNemt in Denmark and delivers roughly 17 million meals a year. Linas Matkasse runs a consumer subscription e-commerce storefront and a "Mina Sidor" customer account area; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Listia
providers.description: Listia is a peer-to-peer marketplace where members give away and acquire secondhand goods using an internal virtual currency ("Points") rather than cash. Launched in 2009 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the service lets members list unwanted items in auction-style listings, earn Points when an item sells, and spend those Points to claim items from other members — a closed-loop credit-and-reputation economy layered on a classic online-auction flow. The site reports over 10 million members, operates iOS and Android apps alongside the web marketplace, and runs adjacent programs including Listia Rewards (redeeming Points for gift cards and retail goods) and Listia Assurance (buyer and seller protection). Listia publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, and no first-party SDKs on npm, PyPI, RubyGems or Packagist. The api.listia.com host serves the same Rails application as the website and acts as the private backend for the mobile apps, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Stance
providers.description: Stance is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand best known for expressive, performance-oriented socks, plus underwear and related apparel sold under the "Feel good, do good" tagline. The company operates a Shopify-hosted online storefront at stance.com with licensed collaborations (MLB, NBA, Disney, and others). Stance publishes no developer product API; its only public machine-facing surface is the Shopify Customer Account API (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0) exposed for customer sign-in at account.stance.com. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and Shasta Ventures and enriched from live probes of its public well-known discovery documents and storefront pages.

providers.name: Ten Little
providers.description: Ten Little is a direct-to-consumer children's footwear and essentials brand that designs healthy, non-toxic shoes for babies and kids. Its APMA-approved shoes use a proprietary TenForm Fit System — wide, foot-shaped toe boxes and flexible zero-drop soles grounded in medical and biomechanical research — to support natural movement and healthy foot development at every size and stage, and to accommodate AFO/SMO orthotics and braces. The brand sells online through a Shopify storefront and publishes no first-party developer API; the only API surfaces reachable on its domain are Shopify's platform-level Customer Account OIDC/OAuth and MCP endpoints.

providers.name: Unicorn Auctions
providers.description: Unicorn Auctions is a Chicago-based online auction marketplace for rare spirits and fine wine, founded in 2019 by A.J. Heindel, Cody Modeer and Phil Mikhaylov out of the city's restaurant and bar trade. Every lot is sold on consignment: Unicorn authenticates, appraises, photographs and digitizes each bottle before listing it in one to three weekly online auctions that can carry several thousand lots spanning bourbon, scotch, Japanese whisky, tequila, agave spirits and wine. The company also runs a bonded vault storage service for collectors, and publishes The Unicorn Review, an editorial and auction-intelligence blog. Bidding is entirely digital, through the web platform and native iOS and Android apps. Unicorn Auctions publishes no public developer program - no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer portal - and the api.unicornauctions.com backend that serves its own clients is private, undocumented and disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Hawthorne
providers.description: Hawthorne is an internet-first men's personal care and grooming brand founded in 2016 in New York City (a Techstars alum, later Series B). It sells personalized, long-lasting fragrance and grooming products — cologne, deodorant, body wash, face and hair care — tuned to a customer's body chemistry and lifestyle through an onboarding quiz and a smart-subscription model built around its "Surround Scent" technology. The direct-to-consumer storefront at hawthorne.co runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: a published /llms.txt and /agents.md, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect discovery, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint so AI shopping agents can search the catalog, build a cart, and complete a buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: JOLYN
providers.description: JOLYN is an athletic swimwear and apparel brand for competitive and team swimming, water polo, and aquatics, known for durable, functional practice and racing suits, team uniforms, and active lifestyle apparel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, JOLYN publishes no first-party developer API — its direct-to-consumer storefront at jolyn.com (jolynclothing.com redirects here) is Shopify-hosted. That platform exposes a genuine agent-native commerce surface: a published /llms.txt with agent instructions, OpenID Connect discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for buyer-approved, agent-driven shopping and checkout.

providers.name: KoRo
providers.description: KoRo (KoRo Handels GmbH) is a Berlin-based direct-to-consumer food retailer that sells nuts, dried fruit, nut butters, snacks, protein products, baking ingredients and drugstore goods in bulk packaging at wholesale-style prices, shipping across Europe from country storefronts in Germany (korodrogerie.de), Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy and the Benelux/EU shop at koro.com. Founded in 2014 and backed by HV Capital and Partech, KoRo runs a headless commerce stack — a Shopware 6 backend fronted by a Nuxt storefront deployed on Vercel — and publishes its engineering work as open source through the KoRoHandelsGmbH GitHub organization, including a Nitro-based Shopware Store-API proxy and several Shopware 6 build-tooling packages on npm under the @korodrogerie scope. KoRo publishes no public developer portal, no documented partner or commerce API, and no API specifications; its Store-API surface is internal and gated behind per-sales-channel access keys.

providers.name: Teabox
providers.description: Teabox is a premium loose-leaf tea brand and direct-to-consumer e-commerce company backed by Accel. It sources fresh Darjeeling, Assam, Nilgiri and other Indian teas direct from gardens and ships them globally through its online store. The storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes an agent-commerce surface built on the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP): a hosted shopping MCP endpoint, a machine-readable llms.txt / agents.md, and OpenID Connect authentication via the Shopify Customer Account API (including a customer-account MCP scope). Buyer checkout always requires explicit human approval. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched from Teabox's public agent-facing surfaces.

providers.name: True & Co
providers.description: True & Co is a direct-to-consumer women's intimates and lingerie brand, originally venture-backed (Cowboy Ventures, Uncork Capital) and now operating under PVH Corp. It sells bras, underwear, and loungewear online through a Shopify-hosted storefront at trueandco.com. The store exposes no traditional developer API, but it does expose a modern agent-commerce surface: a hosted Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for catalog, cart, and checkout, Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OIDC for buyer identity, a public read-only storefront JSON surface, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md.

providers.name: Barn2Door
providers.description: Barn2Door is a Seattle-based commerce and business-management platform purpose-built for independent farmers and local food producers. It gives farms an online store, order and subscription management, inventory tracking, delivery and pickup logistics, integrated payments, and built-in marketing and customer-relationship tools, consolidating the systems a farm needs to sell direct-to-consumer and wholesale into a single dashboard. Barn2Door connects to partners including Mailchimp, QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Avalara, Shippo, Routific, Squarespace, and Facebook, but does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal at this time.

providers.name: Brandback
providers.description: Brandback is a Berlin-based embedded resale infrastructure company (legal entity Arbor Technologies GmbH) that lets online retailers and fashion brands integrate resale directly into their baskets, product listings, and checkouts. Shoppers see an item's future resale value before they buy, resell it later in a single click, and receive store credit, while Brandback's AI handles pricing recommendations, condition checks, customer service, shipping, disputes, and payouts. Retailers can launch a white-label resale marketplace with no upfront cost and integrate with any e-commerce platform. Founded in 2023 and backed by $7.4M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Earlybird VC, Brandback reports a 9.5% average conversion-rate lift with customers including Replay Jeans and Sandqvist.

providers.name: Clearco
providers.description: Clearco (formerly Clearbanc) is a Toronto-based fintech that provides non-dilutive, revenue-based working capital to ecommerce and direct-to-consumer brands. Founders connect the sales, advertising and banking platforms they already run on — Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Square, BigCommerce — and Clearco underwrites from that data, funding inventory and marketing spend as a cash advance or as invoice funding, in as little as 24 hours, without equity dilution. The company was founded in 2015 as Clearbanc, rebranded to Clearco in 2021, and reports having deployed more than $3.3 billion to over 10,000 businesses.

providers.name: Join
providers.description: Join (Join Stories, join-stories.com) is an AI video commerce platform that helps e-commerce brands create, distribute, and measure short-form video across their sales channels. Its products include shoppable video embedded on product and collection pages, user-generated content (UGC) activation from social media, video analytics with A/B testing, an AI Studio that generates video and images from product data, and interactive web stories. Deployment is a single embed snippet with native integrations for Shopify, PrestaShop, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce, and headless storefronts. The company is backed by Canaan Partners and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Storetasker
providers.description: Storetasker is a curated freelance marketplace that connects direct-to-consumer and e-commerce brands with vetted, expert Shopify developers, designers, and marketers for projects and ongoing retainers. Founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars, the platform has helped over 30,000 brands hire trusted Shopify talent across 200+ countries, handling expert matching, communication, project management, and payments. Storetasker operates as a two-sided hiring marketplace rather than a public API provider — as of this pass it publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Yieldify *
providers.description: Yieldify is a website personalization and conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform for ecommerce brands, founded in 2013 in London by Jay Radia and backed by investors including GV (Google Ventures). Its SaaS platform delivers targeted on-site messaging, customer-journey personalization, and A/B testing to lift conversion and revenue. Yieldify was acquired by Publicis Groupe in January 2023 and folded into Epsilon, where it is now sold as Epsilon Accelerate; yieldify.com redirects to the Epsilon Accelerate product page and the legal entity behind the platform is Zeus Enterprise Ltd, trading as Yieldify. Delivery is entirely client-side: a customer-specific JavaScript tag placed before the closing head tag (directly, or via Google Tag Manager, Tealium, Shopify theme.liquid or Recharge checkout) renders a documented library of on-site experience components — overlays, notifications, banners, sticky and embedded experiences, toasters, carousels, countdown timers, lead-capture forms — configured from the Yieldify Conversion Platform at convert.yieldify.com, with a typed dynamic-expression language for personalized copy and client-side yieldify_impression/click/close/form_submit events pushed into the customer's own GA4 property. There is no public developer API: probing every Yieldify host on 2026-08-13 found no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A card, webhooks, SDK, CLI or developer portal, the status page at status.yieldify.com has been deactivated, and no pricing is published anywhere.

providers.name: BabyList
providers.description: Babylist is the leading universal baby registry and a baby-focused commerce and content company for growing families. Because the registry is universal, parents can add any product from any store — including Amazon, Target, and Etsy — to a single list. Babylist has grown into a full ecosystem spanning the Babylist registry, the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health (insurance-covered breast pumps), Babylist Money (family financial planning), expert product guides, and a flagship Los Angeles showroom. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Babylist runs no public developer API, but it does publish an llms.txt agent surface and an OpenID Connect discovery document.

providers.name: DELLI
providers.description: DELLI is a UK online marketplace for independent food and drink makers, founded in 2022 by Depop founder Simon Beckerman with co-founder Marie Petrovicka. Often described as "the Depop for food," DELLI curates niche and small-batch products — snacks, sauces and condiments, pantry staples, drinks, alcohol, sweets and lifestyle goods — from micro-bakers, picklers, olive-oil producers and drink makers, and sells them to consumers, in part through a drop-style release model. The platform has since evolved into an AI-powered companion for makers and retailers, adding tools that cut the operational overhead of running a small food business. DELLI is backed by Balderton Capital and HV Capital, the original investors in Depop. The storefront runs on Shopify; DELLI publishes no first-party developer API at this time.

providers.name: iMotorbike
providers.description: iMotorbike is a Southeast Asian online marketplace and service platform for buying, selling, and servicing pre-owned motorcycles, operating across Malaysia and Vietnam. Sellers submit their bike details, book a free inspection, receive a quotation, and get paid fast, while iMotorbike handles loan settlement and JPJ ownership transfer on their behalf. Buyers shop iM Certified motorcycles backed by a 170-point inspection, a 12-month warranty, and a 6-day return policy, and can book test rides, inspections, and roadside assistance (iM Rescue) through the platform. Founded in 2017 and backed by 500 Global, Headline, Gobi Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, iMotorbike closed a US$10M Series A in 2025 to expand across the region. The company runs a consumer-facing web marketplace and an internal admin platform; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Lenskart
providers.description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer eyewear company operating an omnichannel retail business across prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses and eye-care services. It sells through localized storefronts (India, United States, Singapore and other markets) and mobile apps, and merchandises its own house brands including Vincent Chase, John Jacobs, Lenskart Studio and Lenskart Boost alongside third-party labels. The digital experience layer includes 3D/AR virtual try-on and look comparison, a saved-prescription and prescription-history profile, order tracking and a loyalty program. Lenskart is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this enrichment pass Lenskart publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or client SDKs; the developer- and docs-named subdomains that resolve are gated behind Cloudflare and return 403 to unauthenticated clients, so no API surface could be verified.

providers.name: Speero
providers.description: Speero (سبيرو) is Saudi Arabia's online marketplace for authentic automotive spare parts, accessories, and professional vehicle services. The platform helps car owners find OEM and aftermarket parts for their specific make and model across all major categories (engine, brakes, suspension, lighting, AC, exhaust, and more) and book maintenance, detailing, paint and dent repair, tinting, and tire care at trusted workshops across the Kingdom. It supports browse-by-vehicle, installment payment options, and WhatsApp-based customer support. Speero is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer marketplace and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose a machine-discovery surface (llms.txt, RFC 9116 security.txt, and an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset).

providers.name: Tealet
providers.description: Tealet is a wholesale tea marketplace that connects independent tea growers and family farms directly with retailers and businesses. Buyers browse, trace, and order specialty teas sourced from family farms and cooperatives across 8 countries and 15 growing regions, with grower profiles, farm videos, subscription ordering, and a wholesale request flow that emphasize transparency and direct trade from source to cup. Tealet originated in Hawaii and is backed by 500 Startups and Blue Startups. The company operates a consumer/B2B web storefront with account sign-up, newsletter, and blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or an MCP server.

providers.name: Tuniu
providers.description: Tuniu (途牛旅游网) is a leading online leisure travel company in China, headquartered in Nanjing and listed on NASDAQ under ticker TOUR. It offers packaged tours, self-guided tours, and a broad range of travel-related services and products including hotels, flights, train tickets, cruises, visas, and local activities. For partners, Tuniu runs an Open Platform (途牛开放平台) at developer.tuniu.com that exposes supplier and retail-partner integration APIs behind developer registration, letting suppliers publish inventory and retail partners distribute Tuniu travel products. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Fab.com
providers.description: Fab.com is a digital content marketplace operated by Epic Games, where creators buy and sell 3D models, materials, environments, VFX, audio, and game-ready assets. Launched in October 2024, Fab consolidated four of Epic's prior storefronts — the Unreal Engine Marketplace, the Sketchfab Store, Quixel, and the ArtStation Marketplace — into a single catalog with unified licensing, and integrates into Unreal Engine, UEFN, and the Epic Games Launcher. The fabcom entry was originally added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead for the earlier, unrelated Fab.com flash-sale design-commerce company (2011–2015), which wound down before the domain passed to Epic Games; see x-identity-note. Fab publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification as of this pass — the surface captured here is its documentation, support, and security-disclosure posture.

providers.name: Liftopia
providers.description: Liftopia is a consumer marketplace for advance-purchase ski and snowboard lift tickets, letting travelers browse and buy discounted day tickets and multi-day passes at hundreds of ski areas across the United States, Canada, Europe, South America, Japan, Australia and New Zealand. The site is organized by region, state and destination with dated availability and 1-8 day ticket search, and carries an affiliate program for partners. Liftopia's engineering organization operates on GitHub as Catalate Commerce, Inc., and the site footer points to Spotlio. As of this profile Liftopia publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or client SDKs.

providers.name: Melonn
providers.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Nfinite
providers.description: Nfinite (formerly Hubstairs) is a visual intelligence platform for the digital shelf. It helps consumer brands and retailers automatically analyze, generate, and monitor compliant product visuals — detecting visual compliance gaps across every retailer and brand and fixing them at scale using AI-generated 3D and synthetic product imagery. The product is delivered as a web application (my.nfinite.app) rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or published documentation exists at the time of enrichment. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: SellerX
providers.description: SellerX is a Berlin-based consumer-brand builder, founded in 2020, that acquires, operates and scales everyday consumer products into omnichannel global brands. Originally one of Europe's largest Amazon FBA aggregators, it merged with KW Commerce in 2021 and with the US aggregator Elevate Brands in 2023, and has since repositioned itself from an aggregator into a brand builder. The group operates 20+ brands and 25k+ products across 10+ countries from hubs in Berlin, London, Manila and Dongguan, and has raised more than $750M in equity and debt from Sofina, L Catterton, Cherry Ventures, Felix Capital, 83North, an ADIA subsidiary, BlackRock and Victory Park Capital. SellerX sells consumer goods to consumers through marketplaces and its own channels; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: Teespring
providers.description: Teespring is a creator-commerce and print-on-demand platform, founded in 2011, that lets creators design, launch, and sell custom apparel and merchandise with no upfront cost or inventory, handling production, payment, and fulfillment on the creator's behalf. Backed by a16z, the company rebranded to "Spring" in 2021 and now operates as Amaze Commerce (part of Amaze Holdings): its consumer storefront lives at spri.ng while the creator/merchant SaaS platform runs at amazecommerce.com and amaze.co. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, /.well-known discovery surface, or llms.txt; this profile therefore captures verified company identity and published site properties only.

providers.name: WalkerCo
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands (WalkerCo) is a health and beauty company founded by Tristan Walker that designs grooming and personal-care products for people of color. Its flagship brand, Bevel, sells shaving systems, razors, skin, hair, and beard-care products direct-to-consumer, and the company also operates the FORM hair-care line. Walker & Company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and its storefronts run on Shopify. The company does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its programmatic surface is limited to the Shopify-provided Customer Account OAuth/OIDC endpoints on the Bevel storefront and an internal-tooling GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: Duroflexworld
providers.description: Duroflex (duroflexworld.com) is one of India's most trusted sleep-solutions brands, selling mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows and mattress protectors direct-to-consumer with up to a 10-year warranty, free shipping and EMI options. The online store runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing commerce surfaces discovered by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline: a hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (catalog search, cart, product details, and shop policy/FAQ tools that conform to the UCP catalog capability) and a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, advertising an agent-oriented customer-account-mcp-api scope. Surfaced originally as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead, the profile is now enriched with its MCP, well-known OIDC discovery, authentication, scopes and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: GetHarley
providers.description: GetHarley is a UK-based telehealth and skincare platform delivering personalised, medical-grade skincare through online consultations. Patients answer questions about their skin concerns, book a video consultation, and are matched with one of a network of over 1,000 licensed dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and plastic surgeons, who recommend a tailored regimen of medical-grade products delivered to the patient. GetHarley operates both a patient-facing storefront and a practitioner platform used by clinicians to manage recommendations, orders, and client relationships. Backed by Index Ventures, the company addresses concerns such as acne, fine lines, pigmentation, and ageing. As of this profile, GetHarley does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an MCP server; this record captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Misfits Market (fka Imperfect Foods)
providers.description: Misfits Market is an online grocery delivery service that rescues surplus and cosmetically imperfect produce, plus organic vegetables, dairy, meat, seafood, pantry staples, and wine, delivering sustainable groceries across the United States to help reduce food waste. It merged with Imperfect Foods in 2022, and both brands now operate under Misfits Market. The company has no public developer API program: its digital surface is a consumer e-commerce website, a customer help center, and iOS/Android mobile apps. It publishes a machine-readable llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: TNL Mediagene
providers.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is listed on Nasdaq as TNMG. The group publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI, and no SDK. Its one public, machine-readable integration surface is the Ad2iction header-bidding adapter shipped inside Prebid.js — a first-party-maintained open-source module that posts bid requests to https://ads.ad2iction.com/html/prebid/, documented on the Prebid.org bidder registry rather than on a TNL Mediagene developer site.

providers.name: Womaness
providers.description: Womaness is a women-founded midlife wellness brand created to modernize aging for women and to help them navigate the phases their bodies move through around menopause. The direct-to-consumer company sells clean, estrogen-free, doctor-approved and clinically tested skincare, supplements, sexual-health and menopause-support products (including Let's Neck serum, Melt for You inserts and Daily V Soothe) through a Shopify-hosted online store and select retail partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API surface.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Cuponomia
providers.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. Cuponomia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marley Spoon
providers.description: Marley Spoon is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and grocery company that delivers weekly recipe boxes with pre-portioned ingredients to households, operating the Marley Spoon and Dinnerly brands across markets in the United States, Australia, and Europe. It runs a consumer web and mobile storefront for menu selection, subscription management, and delivery; there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. The company's public GitHub organization hosts only a few internal Ruby infrastructure forks (no client SDKs or specs). Enrichment surfaced no API surface: no /.well-known discovery documents, no security.txt, and no llms.txt. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and remains a company stub with security/identity signals probed rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Poshmark
providers.description: Poshmark is a social commerce marketplace where people in the US, Canada, Australia and India buy and sell new and secondhand fashion, accessories, home goods, beauty products, and electronics. Sellers list items from their closets, share and cross-promote listings across the community, host live selling shows, and ship using prepaid labels while Poshmark handles payments and buyer protection. Founded 2011, IPO 2021, acquired by Naver in 2023. Poshmark runs a consumer web and mobile marketplace backed by internal APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Walker & Co.
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands is a health and beauty products company founded in 2013 by Tristan Walker, best known for Bevel, an end-to-end shaving and grooming system designed for people of color, and for the Form hair-care line. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and others, the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and now operates as a consumer brand whose direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify at getbevel.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company with no first-party developer API program; it was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead. This profile captures its real public web surface (storefront, security.txt, well-known documents, P&G legal and vulnerability-disclosure programs) rather than an API product.

providers.name: Atolls
providers.description: Atolls (formerly Global Savings Group) is a Munich-based consumer commerce-content company that operates the world's largest shopping engagement platform, running coupon, cashback, deals, and shopping-community destinations across more than 20 markets. Its brand portfolio includes Coupons.com, Cuponation, iGraal, Shoop, Pouch, mydealz, hotukdeals, and Deala, connecting millions of shoppers with offers from thousands of retailers and brands through affiliate marketing, cashback, and AI-enhanced shopping insights. Founded in 2012 as CupoNation with Rocket Internet and rebranded to Atolls in 2024, it is backed by investors including HV Capital, RTP Global, and Rocket Internet. Atolls publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI document or SDK — api., developer. and docs.atolls.com do not resolve — but it does serve real machine-readable documents: RFC 9116 security.txt files on five owned hosts pointing at a single group-wide Intigriti vulnerability disclosure program, and OpenID Connect discovery documents on seven Pepper community properties (mydealz, hotukdeals, Dealabs, Preisjaeger, Chollometro, Pepper PL, Promodescuentos) that expose an OAuth 2.0 authorization server for consumer sign-in. This profile captures that security, identity, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cabela's
providers.description: Cabela's is a specialty retailer of hunting, fishing, camping, and outdoor recreation merchandise, operating retail stores and an e-commerce platform. Cabela's is a subsidiary of Bass Pro Shops following the 2017 acquisition, and continues to operate under its own brand with retail locations and a consumer-facing web storefront.

providers.name: Goldbelly
providers.description: Goldbelly is a curated online marketplace for gourmet food and mail-order culinary gifts, shipping iconic meals, desserts, regional specialties, and artisanal products from renowned restaurants, bakeries, and celebrity chefs across the United States directly to consumers' doors. The platform partners with thousands of local and legendary food makers to make hard-to-get regional foods available nationwide, and operates a merchant program ("Sell on Goldbelly") plus corporate and subscription gifting. Goldbelly is a consumer e-commerce brand with no publicly documented developer API; this profile captures its public web, merchant, and corporate identity. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Leflair
providers.description: Leflair is a Vietnamese online retail brand selling discounted authentic international brands across fashion and accessories, beauty and health, home and lifestyle, and children's products. Its own terms of service describe it as Vietnam's first members-only flash-sale platform, running daily promotional events on branded goods. The live storefront at leflair.com is operated by Cong ty TNHH Sopa Technology of Ho Chi Minh City on the Haravan commerce platform, and is supported by a Vietnamese-language editorial blog, an account/sign-in surface, and published terms, privacy, payment-security, shipping, and tax policy pages. Leflair is a consumer retail brand: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API definition, and its historical leflair.vn domain no longer serves the storefront. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: Atoms
providers.description: Atoms is a direct-to-consumer footwear brand founded in 2019 by Waqas Ali and Sidra Qasim and headquartered in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, New York. The company designs, develops, and sells minimalist everyday sneakers - notably its Model 000 and Model 001 lines - and differentiates itself with quarter-size sizing and the ability to buy a pair in two different sizes for each foot. Product features include lightweight foam cushioning, a copper-infused antimicrobial lining, stretch slip-on laces, and an 8mm heel-to-toe drop. Atoms sells online via a Shopify storefront and is backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, DST Global, and Serena Ventures. It has no public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Backbone
providers.description: Backbone is a mobile gaming company that makes the Backbone One controller — a snap-on gamepad for iPhone and Android — and the Backbone app, a mobile gaming platform that unifies a player's game library across cloud gaming, console Remote Play, and streaming services with game discovery, capture, and social features. The company sells hardware and accessories through a Shopify-hosted storefront (backbone.com) that exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint and Shopify Customer Account OIDC. Backbone is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. This profile was enriched from Backbone's public web surface; the company publishes no first-party developer API.

providers.name: BoxGreen
providers.description: BoxGreen (BoxGreen Pte. Ltd., incorporated 2014 in Singapore) is a Certified B Corporation and social enterprise selling all-natural, individually packaged healthy snacks direct to consumers and to businesses. Its consumer offering is a Shopify-based e-commerce store with build-your-own snack boxes, curated collections (nut mixes, crunchies, vegan and gluten-free ranges), gift and party packs, and a subscription delivery model; its B2B side covers corporate gifting, office pantry supply, and cashless healthy-snack vending machines. Every BoxGreen snack is packed in prison by beneficiaries of Singapore's Yellow Ribbon Project to build skills and employability. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company, BoxGreen publishes no first-party API or developer program; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is Shopify's New Customer Accounts OIDC/OAuth discovery.

providers.name: Creative Market
providers.description: Creative Market is an online marketplace for community-generated design assets, where independent creators sell fonts, graphics, illustrations, templates, photos, icons, mockups, add-ons, and 3D assets to designers and businesses. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, the platform operates a storefront and seller dashboard model with per-product commercial licensing, an affiliate and ambassador program, a design blog, and enterprise sales. As of this enrichment pass Creative Market publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, published policy and support surfaces, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Curtsy
providers.description: Curtsy is a mobile-first resale marketplace for secondhand women's fashion, focused on Gen Z and young-millennial shoppers roughly ages 15 to 30. Through its free iOS and Android apps, users buy and sell trending clothing, shoes, and accessories from brands like Lululemon, Free People, and SKIMS, saving up to 70% off retail. Curtsy holds no inventory of its own — sellers ship directly to buyers using prepaid shipping labels and free Curtsy-branded starter kits — and the company earns a 20% fee on each completed sale. Founded in 2016 as part of Y Combinator's Summer 2016 batch and headquartered in San Francisco, Curtsy has raised venture funding from Canaan Partners and Index Ventures. Curtsy is a consumer app with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: FIFOplus
providers.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Fleek
providers.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital. Fleek operates a consumer/reseller storefront (built on Shopify) and a separate vendor onboarding flow for suppliers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from the HV Capital portfolio and enriched from Fleek's public web surface.

providers.name: Freshket
providers.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Garmentory
providers.description: Garmentory is a Seattle-based online fashion marketplace that connects shoppers with more than 1,000 independent boutiques and emerging designers across 30+ countries. Backed by Techstars, the platform curates apparel, accessories, and footwear from independent retailers, letting boutiques list inventory manually or sync it through a Shopify integration. Garmentory runs a heavily customized Spree Commerce (Ruby on Rails) storefront and consumes third-party APIs (payments, retail media, and merchant onboarding) rather than publishing a first-party public developer API. This profile tracks Garmentory's identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network; no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API reference is published at this time.

providers.name: Glambot
providers.description: Glambot is an online marketplace for buying and selling gently used and new makeup and beauty products. Shoppers can purchase discounted cosmetics from more than 100 brands including MAC, Urban Decay, Charlotte Tilbury, and Chanel across categories such as eyes, lashes, brows, face, cheeks, lips, skincare, palettes, and brushes, while sellers can mail in their unwanted makeup for cash payouts. Glambot operates a two-sided consumer resale platform and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public API, SDK, developer portal, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Haz
providers.description: Haz (operated by Vend Solutions Ltd) is a London-based AI social commerce mobile app that connects friends through the things they own and makes it easier to track, buy, and sell second-hand belongings. Its proprietary receipt-reading technology scans digital purchase receipts in a user's email inbox to automatically digitize owned items in real time, removing the manual listing, photography, and description work traditionally required for resale. Users get real-time valuations of everything they own and can offer items to their social circle in a live feed, increasing the liquidity of everyday goods such as clothing and electronics. Haz launched on iOS in March 2024 and raised a $1.4M pre-seed round led by Speedinvest. It is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Highstock
providers.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Imperfect Foods
providers.description: Imperfect Foods is a consumer grocery delivery service focused on reducing food waste. It sources surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and excess-inventory food — produce that is too large or small, packaging overstock, near best-by-date items, and manufacturing byproducts — and delivers them to members at a discount through a weekly, customizable grocery order of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, pantry staples, and snacks. Imperfect Foods was acquired by Misfits Market in 2022 and now operates as part of that company; its consumer web and mobile apps remain live. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment — this profile is maintained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Josh Wood Colour
providers.description: Josh Wood Colour is a UK-based at-home hair colour brand founded by celebrity colourist Josh Wood, selling permanent and semi-permanent hair dye, root touch-up, gloss, toners, blonde and grey-blending products, and haircare direct to consumers through a Shopify-powered online store at joshwoodcolour.com. The brand pairs its retail catalogue with a free personalised colour-matching consultation service and editorial hair-care advice.
