It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail e-commerce brand it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and customer-facing properties.

providers.name: Misfits Market
providers.description: Misfits Market is a subscription-based online grocery delivery service founded in 2018 by Abhi Ramesh and headquartered in Philadelphia. It rescues surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and near-best-by organic produce, pantry staples, dairy, and meat, then delivers them to customers at a discount to reduce food waste. Members shop a personalized storefront during a weekly delivery window with no subscription fees or order minimums, and can skip or cancel anytime. The company acquired rival Imperfect Foods in 2022 and The Rounds in 2025. Backed by Accel and SoftBank Vision Fund. Misfits Market operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Miyokos
providers.description: Miyoko's Creamery (miyokos.com) is a plant-based dairy company in the planetary-health sector, backed by Obvious Ventures, making vegan butter and cheese from cultured cashews, oats, and legumes. The company does not publish a first-party developer REST API; its digital surface is a Shopify-hosted storefront. That storefront exposes a genuine agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a hosted shopping MCP endpoint for search/cart/checkout, Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth for identity, and an /llms.txt with agent instructions. This profile was enriched by probing that public surface.

providers.name: Proudly
providers.description: Proudly is a direct-to-consumer baby care brand, co-founded by Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union, that centers the unique skin and hair needs of Black and Brown babies to make products better for all. Its Shopify-hosted storefront sells skincare (balms, washes, oils), hair care, baby wipes, absorbent diapers, bath and body kits, apparel and gift bundles under a "No Sketchy Stuff" ingredient-transparency commitment. Backed by Initialized Capital (via A-Frame Brands), Atacama Ventures and VMG Partners. Proudly is a consumer commerce company with no public developer API or SDK program; the only machine surface is its Shopify Customer Account OpenID/OAuth well-known configuration.

providers.name: Provi
providers.description: Provi is a B2B beverage alcohol marketplace that digitizes procurement across the three-tier distribution system, connecting buyers (bars, restaurants, and retail stores) with distributors, sales representatives, and suppliers/brands. The platform consolidates product discovery across distributor catalogs, direct messaging with sales reps, order management and processing, and brand showcase tools into a single ordering experience. Provi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sciket
providers.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Sellersfi
providers.description: SellersFi is a financial technology company providing working capital and inventory financing to e-commerce merchants, including sellers on Amazon and direct-to-consumer channels. It offers flexible funding lines with approvals in as fast as 48 hours, helping online businesses manage cash flow, purchase inventory, and scale operations. Backed by Northzone, SellersFi operates a lending platform and applicant portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sesh
providers.description: Sesh (Sesh Products US, Sesh+) is an Austin, Texas consumer packaged goods company that manufactures and sells tobacco-free nicotine pouches. Products ship in multiple flavors (Mint, Wintergreen, Clear, Mango, Cappuccino, Raspberry Lemon) and strengths (4mg, 6mg, 8mg), sold direct-to-consumer via subscription and through 5,000+ retailers. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a physical-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront, so the profile carries identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: Tapstitch
providers.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

providers.name: The Expert
providers.description: The Expert is a consumer marketplace that connects people with top interior designers worldwide through paid one-on-one video consultations, paired with an Expert-curated home shopping marketplace where those designers' product picks can be purchased directly. Founded by celebrity interior designer Jake Arnold and tech entrepreneur Leo Seigal, the company is backed by Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, WndrCo, and others. It operates as a business-to-consumer platform with a trade program for design professionals; it publishes no public developer API. This profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Vetted
providers.description: Vetted (formerly Lustre) is a San Francisco based AI-powered shopping research assistant that helps consumers find the best products and lowest prices. The service analyzes reviews and recommendations from trusted sources such as Reddit, YouTube, user reviews, and expert articles to surface the most recommended brands and products for a shopper's needs, then compares retailers to identify the best available price. Vetted is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience, and is backed by Index Ventures. It exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time (api.vetted.ai serves the mobile apps as a private backend). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Flow Commerce (Global E)
providers.description: Flow Commerce (now part of Global-e) is a cross-border ecommerce platform that lets online merchants localize the entire international shopping experience. It provides localized pricing in 100+ currencies, localized checkout with international payment methods, guaranteed landed-cost (duties and taxes) calculation, international shipping and returns, fraud and compliance handling, and localized product feeds. Flow exposes these capabilities as a REST API defined in APIBuilder, with first-party Ruby and Node.js client SDKs generated from that service definition. Flow.io was acquired by Global-e and now operates as part of the Global-e cross-border enablement platform.

providers.name: 1stdibs
providers.description: 1stDibs is an online marketplace for luxury antiques, vintage and modern furniture, fine art, jewelry, watches, and fashion. It connects a global network of vetted sellers and design dealers with buyers seeking curated, authenticated high-end goods, backed by purchase-protection and authenticity guarantees. 1stDibs does not operate a public REST/OpenAPI developer program; its documented machine-facing surface is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, registered as com.1stdibs/1stDibs, that lets agents browse and search the marketplace.

providers.name: 82 Labs
providers.description: 82 Labs, Inc. (doing business as More Labs) is a Los Angeles-based, science-backed wellness beverage company founded in 2016 by former Tesla engineer Sisun Lee. More Labs makes functional drink supplements sold direct-to-consumer, including Morning Recovery (hydration and post-alcohol recovery with electrolytes and DHM), Liquid Focus (a nootropic caffeine energy shot), and Dream Well (a melatonin and lemon-balm sleep aid). It is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) and e-commerce business with no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment on 2026-07-17 confirmed no API surface exists to harvest.

providers.name: Ascena Retail Group
providers.description: Ascena Retail Group was a specialty apparel retailer that operated multiple women's and tween-girl clothing brands through retail stores, outlets, and e-commerce. The company operated brands including Ann Taylor, LOFT, Lane Bryant, Catherines, Cacique, and others. Ascena filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in July 2020 and sold off its brands. Ann Taylor and LOFT were acquired by Sycamore Partners in 2020 and continue to operate. Lane Bryant and Catherines were also sold to new owners. The company did not expose a public developer API during its operation. Current API resources, if any, exist under the successor brand owners.

providers.name: Gap
providers.description: Gap Inc. is a Fortune 500 American clothing and accessories retailer operating the Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic and Athleta brands. Gap Inc. publishes no public developer API, no machine-readable contract and no developer portal: probing found an Apigee gateway at api.gap.com that exposes no proxy to an anonymous caller, and a dangling developer-portal CNAME at developer.gap.com (gap-api-docs-portal.apigee.net) whose service is gone and whose TLS certificate does not cover the hostname. What Gap does publish is a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme and one first-party open-source Android HTTP library. This repository is an independent third-party profile of that public surface.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Lovepop
providers.description: Lovepop is a Boston-based consumer greeting-card and gifting company, founded in 2014 and known for its intricate laser-cut 3D pop-up cards inspired by Vietnamese "kirigami" paper engineering. The company sells directly to consumers through its Shopify-powered storefront at lovepop.com and through retail partners, offering pop-up greeting cards, gift boxes, flowers, and personalized gifting. Lovepop was accelerated by Techstars and appeared on ABC's Shark Tank. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this pass Lovepop publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, and its public digital surface is a standard Shopify commerce storefront (including Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth well-known documents served on the domain).

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Serena & Lily
providers.description: Serena & Lily is a California home furnishings and lifestyle brand founded in 2003 in Sausalito by textile designer Serena Dugan and entrepreneur Lily Kanter. It sells furniture, custom upholstery, bedding, rugs, lighting, wallpaper, art and home decor direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, a printed catalog, and a network of physical Design Shops, alongside a Designer Circle trade program for interior designers. The storefront runs on a headless, composable commerce stack — Elastic Path for commerce and Amplience for content, served from a Vercel-hosted front end in front of AWS AppSync and Amazon API Gateway — but Serena & Lily publishes no developer program, no public API documentation, and no machine-readable specification of any kind. The GraphQL endpoint backing the storefront answers anonymous requests with introspection disabled, and the api.serenaandlily.com gateway rejects every unauthenticated path.

providers.name: Songfinch
providers.description: Songfinch is a Chicago-based direct-to-consumer music gifting platform that pairs customers with a curated community of independent professional singer-songwriters to produce one-of-a-kind personalized songs. A buyer picks an artist by genre, mood and tempo, submits the story and details behind the occasion through a guided song builder, and the artist writes, records and delivers an original recording to a shareable song page, with add-on products spanning lyric prints, vinyl, CDs, sheet music, QR plaques, streaming release and rights upgrades. Songfinch operates a two-sided marketplace — a consumer storefront plus an artist application and artist admin — and has paid out tens of millions of dollars to independent artists. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract; api.songfinch.com is a private first-party application backend for its own storefront.

providers.name: Tory Burch
providers.description: Tory Burch LLC is an American luxury women's fashion label founded in February 2004 by designer Tory Burch and headquartered in New York City, trading under the legal entity River Light V, L.P. The privately held company designs and sells ready-to-wear clothing, designer shoes, handbags, small leather goods, jewellery, watches, eyewear, fragrance and beauty, swimwear and home decor, together with the Tory Sport activewear line, through roughly 400 boutiques worldwide, wholesale partners and a direct-to-consumer storefront at toryburch.com serving the United States, United Kingdom, the European Union and Asia. Its affiliated Tory Burch Foundation funds and educates women entrepreneurs. Tory Burch is a fashion and retail business rather than a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract, and holds no public GitHub organisation. Its storefront is a Next.js front end on Akamai over a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) commerce platform with Adobe Scene7 media, and an Apigee API gateway fronts www.toryburch.com/api/ for first-party storefront traffic only, exposing no publicly registered proxy. The one machine-readable artifact the company does publish is a site-wide llms.txt.

providers.name: CommerceIQ
providers.description: CommerceIQ is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that helps consumer brands win in algorithmic retail across sales, digital shelf, retail media, and content execution. Its unified platform, Ally AI, packages four AI agents (Content, Shelf, Media, and Sales) that optimize product content and SEO, monitor digital-shelf availability and search rankings across 1,450+ retailers globally, manage and automate retail media bidding and spend, and forecast and execute sales strategy from Amazon and Walmart to Instacart and Criteo. Founded in 2019, CommerceIQ serves enterprise brands including PepsiCo, P&G, Coca-Cola, and Colgate-Palmolive, and is backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Trinity Ventures. The company operates as a managed enterprise platform and does not publish a public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Freshop
providers.description: Freshop is an eCommerce platform purpose-built for grocery and specialty retail, now part of NCR Voyix. It powers branded online storefronts, mobile shopping, order fulfillment, pickup, and delivery for independent and regional grocers, and integrates third-party services for loyalty, coupons, email, SMS, and fulfillment. Freshop exposes a live REST API at api.freshop.com that serves store and product data to Freshop-powered storefronts and apps, authenticated with an application key (app_key) query-string parameter and versioned by a numeric path segment.

providers.name: Grover
providers.description: Grover is a Berlin-based consumer technology rental and subscription company that lets people rent smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, cameras, smart home devices, and audio gear on flexible monthly plans ranging from one to twenty-four-plus months. With more than 500,000 active renters across the United States, Germany, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands, Grover positions flexible tech access as a circular, subscription-based alternative to ownership, refurbishing and recirculating returned devices for resale. Grover is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: IronPlanet
providers.description: IronPlanet is an online marketplace for buying and selling used heavy construction equipment and trucks across categories including construction, trucks, agriculture, mining, forestry, and oil and gas. The platform offers online auctions, buy-now listings, make-an-offer, sealed auctions, and on-site auctions, with detailed third-party inspection reports backed by its IronClad Assurance certification program. IronPlanet operates regional marketplaces for North America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia-Pacific and is part of the Ritchie Bros. (RB Global) family of businesses. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Jinx
providers.description: Jinx is a direct-to-consumer pet nutrition brand selling premium dog and cat food, toppers, and treats at thinkjinx.com. Its product lines span dry kibble, wet food (pate, stews, homestyle), fresh refrigerated meals, jerky and training treats, and meal toppers, formulated with high-quality proteins, probiotics, and superfoods. Backed by Initialized Capital, Jinx sells online and through retail partners. The storefront runs on Shopify; it exposes no first-party public developer API, but the store's Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth discovery is served live from the domain and is captured in this profile.

providers.name: JSW One
providers.description: JSW One Platforms is the digital B2B arm of India's JSW Group, operating a full-stack e-commerce and services platform for the country's manufacturing and construction MSMEs. It runs four connected businesses on one technology stack: JSW One Commerce (jswonemsme.com), a multi-brand marketplace for TMT bars, mild/hot-rolled/cold-rolled and structural steel, coated steel, wire rods, cement and bitumen sourced from certified mills; JSW One Homes (jswonehomes.com), a turnkey home-construction service with digital project tracking across fifteen Indian cities; JSW One Finance, the NBFC arm providing digital credit lines, channel financing and invoice factoring to MSMEs and retailers; and private brands JSW One TMT and One Helix. The platform reported FY25 gross merchandise value of INR 12,567 crore across more than 84,000 registered MSMEs, and raised INR 575 crore in a 2025 round led by the State Bank of India. JSW One publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its customer-facing surfaces are the web marketplace and the JSW One MSME mobile apps. It does publish a maintained llms.txt on both of its consumer properties, plus an explicit AI/LLM bot-access policy on JSW One Homes.

providers.name: Pharmeasy
providers.description: PharmEasy is one of India's largest digital healthcare platforms, operating a consumer online pharmacy and health marketplace at pharmeasy.in. It lets users order prescription and over-the-counter medicines (with prescription upload and verification), buy health and wellness products, book diagnostic lab tests and health checkup packages, and consult doctors via telemedicine, plus a PLUS subscription for recurring savings. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. PharmEasy runs an internal API at api.pharmeasy.in but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI; it does operate a responsible-disclosure security program (infosec@pharmeasy.in). Sector: healthcare / e-pharmacy.

providers.name: Sally Beauty Holdings
providers.description: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is a leading international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. Operates through two segments: Sally Beauty Supply (consumer-facing beauty retail) and Beauty Systems Group (BSG, professional-only distribution). The company serves salon professionals, colorists, and beauty enthusiasts with over 4,800 stores globally.

providers.name: Truemeds
providers.description: Truemeds is an India-based online pharmacy and digital healthcare platform operated by Intellihealth Solutions that lets consumers order branded and generic prescription and over-the-counter medicines for home delivery across India, typically positioned around savings on genuine medicines, free teleconsultation with doctors, and substitute-medicine recommendations. It runs a consumer web and mobile app experience (order medicines, upload prescriptions, health blog, help center) rather than a public developer API program; no public API documentation, developer portal, OpenAPI, or partner API surface was found during enrichment. Backed by Accel and other investors, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Asseta
providers.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: Bravo Sierra
providers.description: Bravo Sierra is an American personal care company founded in New York City in 2018, building high-performance, clean body care for the most active people. Its "military-native" line — deodorant, body wash, cleansing bars, body fragrance, hair styling paste, and antibacterial body wipes — is designed and field-tested with U.S. Special Operations Forces (starting with the 75th Ranger Regiment's 2nd Battalion) and manufactured in the USA. The direct-to-consumer brand runs on Shopify, offers subscriptions, and gives back a portion of every sale to programs supporting active service members, veterans, and their families. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures identity and the store's first-party well-known discovery and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Cherrypick
providers.description: Cherrypick is a London-based food-tech company (backed by Speedinvest) behind an all-in-one meal-planning and grocery-shopping mobile app. The app helps home cooks discover personalized recipes tailored to their dietary preferences, automatically plan their weekly meals, and turn those plans into a supermarket basket at real supermarket prices for home delivery or in-store pickup. Positioned as a lower-cost alternative to recipe-box subscription services, Cherrypick combines recipe discovery, meal planning, and grocery ordering into a single consumer experience aimed at saving people time and money while reducing food waste. Cherrypick is a consumer mobile application with no public developer, API, or partner-integration surface at this time; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Merchbar
providers.description: Merchbar, Inc. is the official merchandise retailer for top musicians, selling vinyl records, CDs, t-shirts, hoodies, posters, and other band merchandise across thousands of artist storefronts at merchbar.com. It runs a consumer shopping experience alongside a "Merchbar for Artists" program and official merchandise integrations with YouTube and Spotify. Merchbar is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Merchbar publishes no public API, developer program, SDKs, or technical documentation — no developer/api/docs subdomain resolves and there is no /.well-known/security.txt — so this profile captures only its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: WE11DONE
providers.description: WE11DONE (pronounced "well done") is a Seoul-based fashion label founded in 2015 by Dami Kwon and Jessica Jung, the duo behind the Seoul concept boutique Rare Market. The brand fuses late-1990s and early-2000s streetwear and athleisure aesthetics into a globally distributed designer ready-to-wear line, sold through its own e-commerce storefront at we11-done.com and stockists worldwide. Surfaced as a consumer-sector portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 confirmed the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail website but publishes no developer API surface: no developer portal, API reference, well-known metadata, or llms.txt were found.

providers.name: Botika
providers.description: Botika is an AI fashion-photography platform that helps online clothing and e-commerce brands replace traditional model photoshoots with generative AI. It turns flat-lay, mannequin, and basic on-model product photos into studio-quality images featuring fully AI-generated fashion models, poses, and on-brand backgrounds. Founded by Eran Dagan and Yarin Didi Meir and backed by an $8M seed round with participation from Seedcamp, Botika ships a web console, a native Shopify app, and an iOS app, cutting photoshoot costs by up to 90% and speeding time-to-market roughly 3x. A public API is on the company roadmap but is not yet released, so this profile currently captures company identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Cars24
providers.description: Cars24 (CARS24 Services Private Limited) is one of India's largest auto-tech companies and an online marketplace for buying and selling used cars, operating across India, the UAE, and Australia. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, Cars24 is an RBI-registered NBFC that combines a used-car transaction platform with financing, insurance, and vehicle-management services. Its offerings include buying and selling pre-owned cars with 300+ point inspections, fixed transparent pricing, warranties, and doorstep delivery; AI-driven used-car valuation; new-car discovery; traffic challan checking and payment; pre-delivery inspections across 220+ cities; vehicle history and service-history reports; car scrapping; FASTag recharge; and used-car loans, loan-against-car, and personal-loan products through Bikes24, Insure24, and related brands. Cars24 is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and 500 Global. It is a consumer platform and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, agent-facing llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Ernesta
providers.description: Ernesta is a direct-to-consumer, custom-sized rug company that lets homeowners and interior-design professionals order high-design rugs made to measure down to the inch. Founded by three Peloton co-founders (John Foley, Hisao Kushi, and Yony Feng) and backed by True Ventures, Addition, and Platform Capital, Ernesta sells online through a Shopify storefront and a growing set of showrooms, and runs a dedicated Trade Program and Trade Portal for designers. Ernesta publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's consumer and trade web properties plus the discovery, security, and identity signals observable on its public hosts.

providers.name: Goodfellow
providers.description: Goodfellow (Goodfellow Advanced Materials) is a global specialty-materials supplier founded in 1946 and headquartered in Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom, serving research, prototyping and specialized manufacturing markets in more than 111 countries. Its catalog spans over 70,000 stocked products drawn from 700+ different materials in many forms, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, compounds and glass, alongside custom fabrication and laboratory testing services. Customers include universities, government research facilities, laboratories and advanced manufacturers, served through subsidiaries in the United States, China, France and Germany. Goodfellow was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2021 to help digitize its operations and fund materials acquisitions. Goodfellow is a business-to-business e-commerce and catalog operation; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks.

providers.name: KupiVIP
providers.description: KupiVIP (kupivip.ru) is a Russian online outlet retailer for luxury and premium fashion, selling women's and men's apparel, footwear, bags, accessories and home goods from more than 250 international designer brands at discounts of up to 90% on previous-season collections. The 1C-Bitrix storefront ships across Russia, publishes a 100% authenticity guarantee backed by expert verification, offers free delivery on orders over 30,000 RUB, and runs telephone, email, WhatsApp and Telegram customer support. The company was originally surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment probe KupiVIP publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: lastminute.com
providers.description: lastminute.com N.V. (SIX Swiss Exchange: LMN) is a European travel-tech group and the regional leader in dynamic holiday packages, operating an online travel agency portfolio that includes lastminute.com, Volagratis, Rumbo, Bravofly, Weg.de, Jetcost and Hotelscan alongside the Forward media/advertising business. The group sells flights, hotels and packaged travel across a global network, and runs an engineering organisation that publishes an open technology blog and a Stoplight-hosted API portal at developers.lastminute.com. That portal is a real partner-facing API surface, but its projects are not anonymously readable — API reference content sits behind a workspace sign-in, so lastminute.com currently exposes no public OpenAPI, SDK, or self-service developer onboarding path.

providers.name: NuORDER
providers.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

providers.name: Popsa
providers.description: Popsa is a UK-based, mobile-first photo printing company that uses AI to help customers create photo books, calendars, prints, tiles, boxes and ornaments in minutes. Founded in the UK and a certified B Corporation that offsets 100% of production and shipping carbon emissions, Popsa serves over 10 million customers and ships to more than 50 countries with localised storefronts across Europe, North America and Australia. Its differentiators are AI-powered automatic layouts, generative captions, facial recognition, print-quality scoring and dynamic colour themes, delivering an average five-minute creation time. Popsa was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; this profile captures its public discovery surface (llms.txt, security.txt) and domain security posture instead.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: FIGS
providers.description: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS) is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. FIGS designs and sells premium scrubwear and non-scrubwear offerings — lab coats, underscrubs, outerwear, footwear, compression socks, loungewear, and accessories — directly to healthcare professionals through its Shopify-based online store at wearfigs.com. FIGS is a consumer e-commerce and retail brand with a customer help center and investor-relations presence; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Hoop
providers.description: Hoop is an AI retention agent for Shopify subscription brands, built by the founding team behind Trello and backed by Index Ventures. It plugs into a brand's helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, or Kustomer), intercepts every subscription-cancellation ticket, and runs a tailored save conversation in the brand's voice: it asks why the subscriber wants to leave, then matches a retention offer (pause, plan swap, discount, or skip) to the stated reason and writes the accepted change back to the billing tool (Recharge or Skio) automatically. Hoop logs every cancellation reason, offer, and outcome so brands learn why subscribers churn, and lets teams A/B test save offers through plain-English policy changes rather than macros. It is an end-user SaaS application rather than an API provider — it consumes the Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Recharge, and Skio APIs and exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation of its own.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Vinted
providers.description: Vinted is a European consumer-to-consumer (C2C) online marketplace for buying and selling secondhand clothes, shoes, accessories, and other lifestyle items, operating across web and mobile apps in dozens of markets. Founded in Vilnius, Lithuania, it is one of Europe's largest secondhand fashion platforms and is backed by Accel, Insight Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Vinted does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public identity, legal, and security (security.txt / domain-security) surfaces.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: Arena Club
providers.description: Arena Club is a technology-first trading-card and collectibles platform founded in 2022 by entrepreneur Brian Lee and baseball Hall-of-Famer Derek Jeter, operating as Arenaclub.com, Inc. The company combines AI- and computer-vision-assisted card grading, an insured physical vault with 24/7 surveillance and climate control, a digital "Showroom" where collectors organize vaulted cards into collections, and an online marketplace for buying, selling and trading slabbed sports and trading-card-game cards. Members submit cards for grading and vaulting, browse and transact in the marketplace, open digital packs, and can retrieve physical cards from the vault on demand. Arena Club ships web and native iOS/Android apps but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: birchbox
providers.description: Birchbox is a beauty and grooming subscription-box retailer that sends members a monthly assortment of personalized deluxe samples across skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance, then lets them purchase full-size versions of what they like in its online shop. Originally a New York startup and later acquired, the brand today runs a direct-to-consumer subscription and e-commerce storefront at birchbox.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Branddu
providers.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Carma
providers.description: Carma is an Australian online used-car retailer that lets consumers buy, sell, and trade in pre-owned vehicles entirely online. Every car is inspected and reconditioned, and the platform bundles financing through partner lenders, home delivery, trade-in valuations, a 7-day money-back guarantee, a 3-month warranty, and NRMA roadside assistance as an alternative to the traditional dealership experience. Backed by General Catalyst since 2022, Carma is headquartered in Sydney, Australia. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and enriched from Carma's public web surface; Carma publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Casper
providers.description: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer sleep and home goods brand that sells mattresses, bedding, pillows, and sleep accessories online at casper.com and through retail partners. Its casper.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md with agent instructions, the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for AI agents to search, cart, and check out, and Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect authentication. Casper was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP and Slow Ventures and enriched from its live public agent/commerce surface.

providers.name: Circulo de Belleza
providers.description: Círculo de Belleza is an authorized distributor of professional beauty products in Mexico, operating an e-commerce storefront at circulodebelleza.com. It sells salon-quality hair care, hair color, nail, barbershop, and facial/spa supplies from 40+ professional brands (L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Wella, Schwarzkopf, Matrix, Alfaparf Milano) at professional pricing with no minimum purchase, same-day fulfillment, and nationwide Mexico delivery. The store is built on Shopify and exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md, OpenID Connect and OAuth authorization-server discovery documents, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: Enjoei
providers.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Grove
providers.description: Grove (Grove Collaborative) is a direct-to-consumer retailer of everyday household essentials for a healthier home and planet, including eco-friendly cleaning products, bamboo paper products, personal care, and vitamins & supplements sourced from hundreds of vetted brands alongside its own private labels. Orders are held to strict ingredient standards, are carbon neutral, and support plastic-waste cleanup. The business runs as a subscription-friendly e-commerce storefront (hosted on Shopify). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Grove operates a consumer retail storefront and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its identity and web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Livsn Designs
providers.description: Livsn Designs is a Techstars-backed outdoor apparel brand that makes durable, minimalist technical clothing (its Flex Canvas pants and multi-use travel and hiking apparel) sold direct-to-consumer from a Shopify storefront at livsndesigns.com. It publishes no first-party developer API or documentation portal. Its only programmatic surface is the agent-commerce layer Shopify serves on the merchant's own domain: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven checkout, a Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth2 authorization server, and an llms.txt / agents.md agent-instructions document. This profile captures that real agent surface; there is no bespoke API to catalog.

providers.name: Our Place
providers.description: Our Place is a direct-to-consumer kitchenware and cookware brand, best known for the multi-purpose Always Pan, selling cookware, bakeware, appliances, tableware, and kitchen tools at fromourplace.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, its digital storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a native agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect authentication, and an agent-facing llms.txt / agents.md. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's live public agent surface.

providers.name: Prime Roots
providers.description: Prime Roots is a Berkeley, California foodtech company making koji- and plant-based deli meats and bacon marketed as "the clean deli meat" — no preservatives, nitrates, or celery salt. It sells direct-to-consumer and through foodservice, running its online store on Shopify. That storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: an llms.txt / agents.md agent guide, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, https://ucp.dev) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted MCP endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Prosus Ventures portfolio company and enriched from its live public discovery surfaces.

providers.name: Purely B
providers.description: PurelyB is a natural superfood and wellness brand founded by Raja Jesrina Arshad, rooted in ancestral Asian health traditions and selling halal-certified, vegan, gluten-free herbal supplements (Pegaga, Tiger Milk Mushroom, Manjakani, Super Immune-C and a SuperKids line) direct to consumers across Malaysia and Singapore. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a standards-based agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted MCP shopping server, Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC, and a published llms.txt for AI shopping agents. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its public developer/agent surface.

providers.name: The House Of LR&C
providers.description: The House of LR&C (Love, Respect & Care) is a Seattle-based, mission-driven direct-to-consumer fashion company founded in 2020 by Russell Wilson, Ciara, and retail veteran Christine Day. A Certified B Corporation, it operates a portfolio of apparel brands including Good Man Brand, LITA by Ciara, and Human Nation, donating 3% of net revenue to the Why Not You Foundation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public commerce runs on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. The only machine-readable surface on the storefront host is Shopify's platform-level Customer Account API OIDC discovery document.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: Vastrm
providers.description: Vastrm is a custom-tailored menswear e-commerce company selling made-to-fit polo shirts with 24 different fits and sizes plus additional free adjustments, an online design-your-own configurator, corporate solutions for businesses, and a retail partners program. Vastrm is a Y Combinator and a16z-backed company tracked in the API Evangelist network; it operates a consumer storefront at vastrm.com and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Weee
providers.description: Weee! is America's largest online Asian grocery store and delivery platform, operating as a direct-to-consumer online supermarket serving major metropolitan areas across the United States. It curates and fulfills inventory through regional distribution centers and cold-chain logistics, bringing together products and ingredients commonly found in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Filipino, and Indian supermarkets. The storefront spans fresh produce, frozen meats, seafood, pantry staples, snacks, sauces, hot pot ingredients, beverages, and household essentials, accepts EBT/SNAP in eligible cities, and runs a multilingual experience (English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Thai). Weee is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile Weee publishes no public developer API; this record captures its public web identity and AI-indexing (llms.txt) surface.

providers.name: Deposco
providers.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

providers.name: Dianxiaomi
providers.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

providers.name: Plobal Apps
providers.description: Plobal Apps is a no-code mobile app builder for Shopify merchants that turns online stores into native iOS and Android shopping apps without engineering. The platform offers drag-and-drop app design with HTML/CSS/JavaScript code blocks, push-notification marketing campaigns, live selling, AI-powered product recommendations, advanced search and smart filtering, and real-time analytics tracking 60+ in-app actions, plus omnichannel flows such as in-app ordering with in-store pickup. It installs through the Shopify App Store and is used by direct-to-consumer brands to grow mobile commerce revenue and customer retention.

providers.name: Astro Sea
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia), operating at astronauts.id, is an Indonesian quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and everyday essentials in as little as 15 minutes. Its consumer mobile apps (iOS and Android) offer more than 3,000 curated products spanning fresh produce, frozen goods, groceries, beauty, household items, and electronics, with 24/7 service across the Greater Jakarta (JADETABEK) region. Astro is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio into the API Evangelist network. Astro is a business-to-consumer application company; it publishes a consumer app, a corporate site, and an RFC 9116 security contact, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Brumbrum
providers.description: Brumbrum is an Italian online used-car marketplace, part of the pan-European Aramis Group, that sells certified pre-owned vehicles fully online with home delivery, financing, trade-in (permuta), warranty coverage, a 14-day return trial and a best-price guarantee. Vehicles are inspected and reconditioned at its Reggio Emilia facility (300+ quality checks) with retail presence near Milan. Brumbrum is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification. This profile in the API Evangelist network captures the company's public web identity and the security/discovery signals probed from its domain.

providers.name: Highbeam
providers.description: Highbeam is a business banking and finance platform built for modern consumer brands (direct-to-consumer and e-commerce). It brings together operating and high-yield accounts, a charge card that pays cashback on advertising spend, working capital and credit lines, automated bill pay, and spend intelligence, alongside Luma, an applied-AI finance assistant. Banking services are delivered through partner banks (Thread Bank, member FDIC) and Airwallex. Highbeam is based in New York City. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this entry captures the company identity, its public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Blidz
providers.description: Blidz is a membership-based social and gamified e-commerce platform ("Make Money, Save Money, Have Fun") offering deeply discounted deals across grocery, electronics, home goods, and other consumer categories through its iOS and Android shopping apps. Backed by General Catalyst, Blidz operates a consumer mobile marketplace rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web domain.

providers.name: Divi Official
providers.description: Divi Official Inc. (Divi Growth Care) is a direct-to-consumer haircare and scalp-care brand formulated "for women by women," selling vegan, science-backed serums, shampoos, conditioners and supplements aimed at the hair-growth journey. The company operates an e-commerce storefront hosted on Shopify at diviofficial.com, with a subscription "Club Divi" program, a content blog, and a customer-account experience. Divi is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It is a consumer packaged goods / beauty commerce business and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify Customer Accounts OAuth/OIDC discovery documents that the storefront platform exposes. This profile captures the company's public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dollar Shave
providers.description: Dollar Shave Club is a direct-to-consumer men's grooming and personal-care brand founded in 2011 and acquired by Unilever in 2016, best known for pioneering the subscription razor model that ships blades, shave butter, skincare and body-care products to members on a recurring schedule. The company sells through its own e-commerce storefront (dollarshaveclub.com, built on Shopify) as well as retail channels, offering razor handles and cartridges, grooming kits and gift sets. It surfaces in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Dollar Shave Club does not operate a public developer program or documented API; its digital surface is a consumer Shopify storefront whose only machine-discoverable interface is Shopify's customer-account OAuth/OIDC (including a customer-account MCP API scope) exposed at the store's /.well-known/ discovery endpoints.

providers.name: Grove Collaborative
providers.description: Grove Collaborative is a digital-first consumer products company and online marketplace for sustainable everyday household essentials — eco-friendly cleaning supplies, bamboo and recycled paper products, personal care, beauty, pet, and vitamins & supplements from hundreds of vetted brands. Orders meet strict ingredient standards and are carbon neutral, and the company operates as a plastic-neutral, sustainability-focused retailer sold through grove.co (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and retail partners. Grove is a public benefit company (NYSE: GROV) that was an early portfolio company of 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. It publishes no first-party developer API or public developer program; this profile captures its public web, security, and Shopify-platform discovery surface.

providers.name: Hidrate
providers.description: HidrateSpark is the world's smartest water bottle brand, tracking daily water intake with a Bluetooth-connected sensor puck that glows to remind you to drink and syncs to the HidrateSpark hydration app, Fitbit, and Apple Watch. The company (originally Hidrate, Inc., a Techstars-backed startup) sells its smart bottles and accessories through a Shopify-hosted direct-to-consumer storefront at hidratespark.com. It does not publish a first-party developer or product API; the only machine-facing surface is the Shopify platform layer — OIDC/OAuth customer accounts and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) agent-commerce endpoints that let buyer-approved AI shopping agents browse and check out.

providers.name: Mayvenn
providers.description: Mayvenn is an Oakland, California beauty-commerce company that sells quality virgin human hair extensions, sew-in weave bundles, closures, frontals, and human hair wigs directly to consumers and through a network of more than 100,000 hair stylists. Founded by Diishan Imira and backed by a16z and 500 Global, Mayvenn pairs its hair products with a stylist-driven distribution model and a 30-day return policy, running its storefront on Shopify at shop.mayvenn.com. The company does not currently publish a public first-party developer API; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and commercial link surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Novi
providers.description: Novi Connect is an AI shopping optimization platform for consumer packaged goods (CPG) and retail brands. Its AI Shopping Optimizer structures and optimizes product data feeds so that AI systems, agentic search, and commerce assistants can accurately understand, trust, and recommend products, while its Product Authority Builder verifies and distributes product data through direct feeds with major retailers and marketplaces. Novi Connect is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Greylock.

providers.name: OrderCircle
providers.description: OrderCircle is a B2B wholesale order management software platform, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that gives fast-growing brands one system to automate wholesale orders, track inventory in real time, generate invoices, and run a self-service B2B eCommerce portal for their buyers. It targets wholesale operations in apparel, coffee, jewelry, food and beverage, hemp, vape, and CBD, and connects to existing tools through pre-built integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, ShipStation, Stripe, Square, PayPal PayFlow, and Authorize.Net. OrderCircle does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its programmatic surface is limited to its packaged third-party integrations. This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Packhelp
providers.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

providers.name: Saysh
providers.description: Saysh is a direct-to-consumer athletic footwear and apparel brand founded by Olympic champion sprinter Allyson Felix, designing sneakers engineered specifically for women's biomechanics under the banner "Women Deserve Better." Its lineup spans performance running shoes (the Felix Runner and Evelyn Runner) and the everyday Saysh One, plus apparel, accessories, and the Saysh+ Run Club membership. The saysh.com storefront runs on Shopify, so customer-facing commerce is served through the Shopify platform rather than a first-party Saysh developer API; no public Saysh API program, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal were found. Backed by Redpoint Ventures.

providers.name: Tiff's Treats
providers.description: Tiff's Treats is an Austin, Texas cookie company founded in 1999 by University of Texas students Tiffany Taylor and Leon Chen, built around warm, baked-to-order cookies delivered same-day. The company operates roughly 90 bakery-storefronts across Texas and the southern and western United States, combining walk-in retail with an owned delivery fleet, an online ordering platform at cookiedelivery.com, and iOS and Android ordering apps. Alongside consumer delivery it runs a substantial corporate gifting, catering, e-gift-card and special-events business, plus an "Elites" subscription membership and a rewards program. Tiff's Treats has raised more than $50 million in outside investment, including a $25 million round led by Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital, and counts Andy Roddick, Brooklyn Decker, Kendra Scott and Dirk Nowitzki among its investors. It is a direct-to-consumer food and delivery operator, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Wonderskin
providers.description: Wonderskin is a direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand best known for its WONDER BLADING all-day peel-off lip stain, along with longwear eyeliners, serum foundations, blush, brow products, skincare, and beauty tools sold through its Shopify-powered online store. The company runs a SKINSIDER loyalty membership, publishes THE SKINSIDER beauty and lifestyle blog, and partners with athletes and celebrities on product marketing. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Insight Partners. As a consumer e-commerce retailer, Wonderskin publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures the brand identity, customer-facing web properties, and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Boldr
providers.description: Boldr is a Techstars-backed consumer hardware company building energy-saving smart home climate control devices. Its two products are Kelvin, a smart infrared heater, and Klima, a smart thermostat controller for mini-split air conditioners that also monitors appliance health so units last longer with fewer issues. Both devices are managed through the Boldr mobile app, which lets homeowners control climate settings remotely and track energy usage to lower utility bills. Boldr also runs Boldr Pro, a program for HVAC contractors. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted online store at shopboldr.com and does not currently publish a first-party developer API; its only public machine-readable surface is the Shopify Customer Account OIDC discovery served at the storefront host.

providers.name: EcomExperts
providers.description: EcomExperts is a Latin American ecommerce ERP and technology platform that helps online sellers manage, synchronize, and automate their stores from a single screen. It centralizes omnichannel operations across marketplaces and sales channels (including multi-account Mercado Libre management), synchronizes prices and stock in real time, and issues electronic invoices automatically in bulk. Delivered as a SaaS application with a hosted dashboard and a 7-day free trial, EcomExperts operates across Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EcomExperts does not currently publish a public developer platform, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures company identity and public-surface signals only.

providers.name: Eloquii
providers.description: ELOQUII is a plus-size women's fashion retailer offering trend-driven, fashion-forward apparel and accessories in sizes 14 through 32, including dresses, workwear, outerwear, denim, and occasion wear with frequent seasonal collection refreshes. Known for its fit-obsessed design and inclusive sizing, the brand operates a direct-to-consumer ecommerce storefront at eloquii.com alongside select retail locations. ELOQUII was founded as a plus-size line, acquired by Walmart in 2018, and is now part of FullBeauty Brands. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer ecommerce experience but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Fig 1
providers.description: Fig.1 (Figure 1 Beauty) is a direct-to-consumer skincare brand created through 8VC's Build program, co-founded with Harvard-trained dermatologist Dr. Courtney Rubin, focused on demystifying and democratizing skincare through transparent, efficacy-driven, in-house formulations sold across a small launch line of cleansers, treatments, and moisturizers. Its public surface is a Shopify-hosted ecommerce storefront at fig-1.co; Fig.1 publishes no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation. This API Evangelist profile records the brand's identity, storefront policy pages, and domain-security posture. The /.well-known/openid-configuration served on the host is Shopify's shared Customer-Account platform OIDC, not a Fig.1 API.

providers.name: Mophones
providers.description: Mophones (MoPhones) is a Nairobi, Kenya based fintech and recommerce company building accessible device-financing and re-commerce infrastructure for Africa, starting with premium refurbished smartphones from brands like Apple and Samsung sold with flexible weekly-installment and pay-on-delivery plans. The consumer storefront runs on Shopify at mophones.co and does not expose a first-party developer API; its only programmatic surface is the Shopify-provided agentic-commerce layer — a published Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile at /.well-known/ucp and a live UCP-over-MCP shopping endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp that lets buyer-approved AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete Shop Pay checkouts. Mophones is backed by Speedinvest and was noted as the first African startup to secure NICE financing from STV.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: PCA SKIN
providers.description: PCA SKIN is a professional skincare brand specializing in dermatologically tested chemical peels and result-oriented corrective products, positioned as a leading professional chemical-peel brand among estheticians and skincare professionals. The brand's direct-to-consumer store at pcaskin.com is built on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: it implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) with a hosted MCP endpoint plus read-only storefront JSON, so AI shopping agents can discover the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the store's published agent surface (/llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp).

providers.name: Sonans
providers.description: Sonans is an AI software company building an intelligence layer for fashion merchandising. Its collaborative AI agents replace manual coordination with autonomous workflows that bridge buying decisions and cross-functional execution, turning raw design sketches and purchase orders into production-ready assets including photorealistic product imagery, marketing copy, and catalog data synchronized across ERPs, Shopify, and B2B commerce platforms. Sonans serves fashion brands and designers (streamlining design cycles, asset enrichment, and multi-channel product launches) as well as retailers and merchants (automating assortment planning, catalog enrichment, and inventory management). The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Sonans operates a web application at app.sonans.ai but publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: TTRacing
providers.description: TTRacing is a Malaysian gaming chair and gaming furniture brand selling ergonomic gaming chairs, office chairs, and accessories through an online Shopify storefront at ttracing.my. The store is agent-commerce ready: it publishes an llms.txt and agents.md with explicit agent instructions, a UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and run buyer-approved checkout. Human customer accounts are handled via Shopify's OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authorization server. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from live probes of its public agent-facing surface.

providers.name: Wizard
providers.description: Wizard is an AI-powered personal shopping agent for consumers. Shoppers describe what they want in natural language and Wizard searches across retailer websites, customer reviews, trusted editorial, and social content to return a tightly curated set of product recommendations, with direct checkout from retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Apple, and Target. The company is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wizard is a consumer-facing web/app product and exposes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface (developer/docs/api subdomains and /.well-known/security.txt all return 404).

providers.name: Beengo
providers.description: Beengo operates as Appfront (appfront.ai), an all-in-one restaurant engagement and eCommerce platform backed by 500 Global. The platform gives restaurants branded online ordering, dine-in scan-and-pay, loyalty and CRM, SMS/push/email marketing campaigns, gift cards and payments, branded native iOS/Android apps, and data analytics. It integrates with major point-of-sale systems (Toast, Revel, SpeedLine, Square, Clover, PAR/Brink, Oracle Hospitality MICROS, NCR) and third-party delivery (DoorDash, Postmates). No public developer program, OpenAPI, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company identity, web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: BloomNation
providers.description: BloomNation is a flower-delivery marketplace that connects consumers with independent local florists for same-day and next-day delivery of handcrafted floral arrangements across 40+ U.S. cities and the UK. Customers shop florist-designed bouquets for occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, and get-well, then pay with credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, or Afterpay. Distinctive features include BloomSnap photo delivery confirmation and video message cards. BloomNation also runs a florist-facing SaaS side (point-of-sale, website, and order management, now part of Promenade) that powers member shops. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cheerz
providers.description: Cheerz is a French direct-to-consumer photo-printing brand. Customers pick photos from their phone camera roll or a connected cloud gallery in the Cheerz iOS/Android app or on cheerz.com, and Cheerz prints and ships the result as photo prints, fridge magnets, photo books and albums, wall canvases, framed prints and posters, calendars including advent calendars, puzzles, greeting and invitation cards, and the branded Cheerz Box and Memory Box gift formats. Founded in Paris in 2012 under the legal entity Printklub, backed by Serena Capital and Iron Capital, and acquired by the German photo-finishing group CEWE Stiftung & Co. KGaA in February 2018 for roughly EUR 45 million; it continues to operate as CEWE's Paris site. Cheerz publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind — it is an end-user retail product, and partnership, bulk-order and affiliate enquiries are handled by a human contact channel rather than a developer programme.

providers.name: Dick's Sporting Goods
providers.description: DICK'S Sporting Goods is a Fortune 500 omni-channel sporting goods retailer selling sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories across the DICK'S, House of Sport, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Going Going Gone banners. It publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract: the storefront is an Angular single-page app that answers HTTP 200 with the same shell for every path, and neither api. nor developer.dickssportinggoods.com resolves in DNS. Its B2B integration surface is X12 EDI over AS2/SFTP through third-party trading networks, with vendor guidelines handed out as PDFs. The company does run a named Vulnerability Disclosure Program on Bugcrowd.

providers.name: Giftly
providers.description: Giftly is a digital gifting platform that lets anyone send a flexible monetary gift redeemable at a specific local or national business, or as cash. Senders pick a place or category, customize the card design and tagline, choose a gift amount up to $1,000, and deliver it by email, text, print, or mail. Recipients redeem a Giftly gift as a Visa or Mastercard gift card by mail, as a credit to their bank account, or as a credit to their PayPal account; gifts never expire and carry no inactivity fees. Giftly also runs a corporate and business program for companies sending gifts at scale. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital; Giftly publishes a consumer web product and a business portal, but no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Stockly
